manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Hostage Taker, and Glorious Protector must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Glorious Protector for its mana cost.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
